name: Fried Fish (Mas Bhaji)
ingredients: Fresh tuna or reef fish fillets
instructions: 1. Clean the fish fillets thoroughly and pat dry.
2. In a bowl, combine turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander powder, ginger-garlic paste, salt, and lemon juice to form a thick paste.
3. Coat the fish pieces evenly with the spice paste and let them marinate for 20-30 minutes.
4. Heat coconut oil in a traditional heavy-bottomed pan.
5. Add a few sprigs of fresh curry leaves to the oil for aroma.
6. Place the fish fillets in the pan and shallow-fry over medium heat until golden brown and crispy on both sides.
7. Serve hot as an appetizer or a side dish with steamed rice.
description: Mas Bhaji reflects the island's deep-rooted connection to the Arabian Sea. As fishing is a primary occupation in Lakshadweep, this dish highlights the freshness of the local catch, elevated by the ubiquitous use of coconut oil, which is a hallmark of the culinary tradition of the archipelago.
